_help: Claude produces and updates this file in analysis sessions; the panel reads its store copy, localization pack and dated recommendations from here. Schema and method: skills/marketinghub/. The engine (refresh.py) never touches it. / TR: Bu dosyayı Claude analiz oturumlarında üretir; motor (refresh.py) dokunmaz.

_schema_recommendations.area: roadmap | aso | video | tags | radar | playbook | i18n | campaign | general
_schema_recommendations.title: One line, phrased as an action
_schema_recommendations.detail: Why + how. Ground it in data: which scan finding triggered this?

_schema_asoSuggestions.field: iosTitle | iosSub | iosKw | iosPromo | iosDesc | iosWhatsNew | gpShort | gpLong
_schema_asoSuggestions.value: The final text to PASTE into the field (within its character limit)
_schema_asoSuggestions.reason: Why this text? Note any rejected alternative too, so the next session doesn't repeat the same debate.
_schema_asoSuggestions._limits: iosTitle 30 · iosSub 30 · iosKw 100 · iosPromo 170 · iosDesc 4000 · gpShort 80 · gpLong 4000

_localizationNote: Every language is SEPARATE keyword research, not a translation — use the terms people actually search for in that language. The brand name is preserved; the keyword field is the local equivalent of the English concept list, with no invented words.

_schema_localization.lang: tr | de | pl | ar | es | pt-BR | fr | ru … (panel language code)
_schema_localization.name: Display name of the language
_schema_localization.country: DE — which market this pack targets
_schema_localization.why: Why is this language a priority? Tie it to a radar finding.
screens: Screenshot strip headings — same order as in the source language
